# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **macOS typeface race fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.1 fixes a macOS typeface cache data race in the bundled Skia engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface cache race fixed** — Concurrent typeface access no longer races over the cached stream state in `SkTypeface_mac_ct`. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
